components.ringdown: sum_n A_n exp(-dt/tau_n) cos(2 pi f_n dt + phi_n)

hard_invariants: response is zero before the retarded event time
damping times are finite and positive
tail scale and memory rise time are finite and positive
mode quality factor is a signal convention Q = pi f tau
amplitudes are strain-like references unless a source-specific derivation supplies units
strain-to-energy or strain-to-cascade-threshold mapping remains TOKEN_VAZIO
no exotic gravitational echo is implied by the curvature-like tail term
source_specific_requirements: derive mode frequencies and damping times from a declared source model or validated numerical-relativity result
separate memory, tail and instrumental/systematic residuals

cascade_composition.reason: No universal conversion from strain-like response amplitude to Joule-valued cascade trigger is derived.

claim_boundary: This module implements a causal signal decomposition for experimentation. It is not a GR field solver and does not demonstrate a new gravitational reverberation phenomenon.
